products.shortDescription: Hybrid MPPT solar charge controller with B.M.S — auto 12V/24V, PV input up to 170V, smart solar/grid switching and 3-stage charging.
products.description:
## Overview

The **Exotech MPPT Plus Hybrid EXO-M-100** is a solar charge controller with a built-in B.M.S (Battery Management System). It charges your battery from solar panels and automatically switches to grid power when the sun isn’t enough — so your inverter/UPS always has a charged battery behind it.

It auto-detects **12V or 24V** battery systems on every start-up and accepts PV input up to **170V**. It includes **solar reverse polarity protection** and stops charging with a “HIGH PV VOLTAGE” warning if the array exceeds 150V.

## Smart solar + grid (hybrid) charging

- **Solar charging mode** — when solar energy is sufficient, the battery is charged from the panels only (yellow LED).
- **Hybrid charging mode** — when battery capacity falls below 50% or solar is insufficient, grid supply is switched on to assist charging until the battery reaches 100% (blue LED).
- **Stand-by mode** — if solar is interrupted, the grid charges the battery and the LCD shows “PV INTERRUPTED”.

## 3-stage charging for longer battery life

- **Constant current (CC)** bulk charging
- **Constant voltage (CV)** absorption charging
- **Float / trickle** charging — the green LED turns steady and the LCD shows “BATTERY CHARGED”

## Protections

- Battery over-charge protection (cuts off above 15V in 12V mode / 30V in 24V mode)
- High PV voltage warning and cut-off
- Solar reverse current protection
- Over-current and over-heat protection with automatic cooling fan
- Low battery alarm and indication

## Display & settings

The LCD shows PV voltage and current, battery voltage and charging current, and warning messages. Four LEDs show solar mode, charging/full, warning and hybrid mode. Battery full, float, solar/hybrid switch-over, DC load on/off and low-battery alarm voltages are all adjustable from the UP / DOWN / ENTER keys.

## Installation notes

- Mount vertically at eye level on a sturdy wall, in a shaded, airy place — not in direct sunlight.
- Use a DC breaker between the panels and the MPPT, and between the MPPT and the battery.
- Connect the battery first when installing; disconnect the solar first when removing.
- For best performance use at least 4 and up to 6 × 550W panels. Wiring should be done by a qualified installer.

products.name: 3-Stage Automatic Battery Charger

images.alternativeText: Exotech 3-stage automatic battery charger, blue metal enclosure

products.shortDescription: Fully automatic 3-stage battery charger with LED status indicators for charging, trickle charging, battery charged and over-heat.
products.description:
## Overview

The **Exotech 3-Stage Automatic Battery Charger** takes care of your battery on its own: it charges, tops up with a trickle charge and tells you when the battery is full — no manual switching required.

## LED status panel

- **Batt. Charging** (red) — battery at or below 11.2V and charging
- **Trickle Charging** (yellow) — battery at or above 13.8V, topping up
- **Battery Charged** (green) — battery at or above 14.2V, fully charged
- **Over Heated** (red) — temperature warning

## Build

- Rugged wall-mount metal enclosure with silver end caps
- Sealed cable glands for input and output wiring
- 100% original Exotech product

products.description:
## Overview

The **Exotech Digital Battery Charger** shows what your battery is doing at a glance on a bright 3-digit LED display, backed by three indicator lights.

## Indicators

- **Digital display** — live charging reading
- **Charging** (yellow)
- **AC/DC Power** (red)
- **Battery Full** (green)
- Temperature indicator on the front panel

## Build

- Wall-mount metal enclosure in silver-grey
- Sealed cable glands for input and output wiring
- 100% original Exotech product

The **Sencor SH 30A** is a 12 volt battery charger rated at 30 amps, with two digital displays so you can see both the mains and the charging current at the same time.

## Dual digital display

- **CHG / FUL** — charging current and battery-full indication (amps)

- Screw-fixed front panel

items: How do I place an order?
Add products to your cart and checkout with your name, phone and address. You can also order directly on WhatsApp from any product page.
Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
Yes — COD is available across Pakistan (except restricted regions). You can also pay by bank transfer or JazzCash/Easypaisa.
Can I change or cancel my order?
Yes, before it’s dispatched. Call or WhatsApp us with your order number and we’ll update it.
2–3 working days in major cities and 3–5 working days elsewhere.
Free on orders above Rs. 5,000. A flat Rs. 250 applies below that.
Which areas do you deliver to?
All of Pakistan except Balochistan and Azad Kashmir at the moment.
100%. We source directly from brands and authorised distributors, and every product ships with its official warranty card.
Contact us with your order number and a short video of the issue. We’ll arrange repair or replacement per the brand’s warranty terms.
Unused products in original packaging can be returned or exchanged within 3 days of delivery.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
body: We collect only the information needed to process your order — name, phone, email and delivery address.
Your data is never sold or shared with third parties except courier partners for delivery.
You can request deletion of your account data at any time by contacting support.

delivery.title: Delivery policy
body: Orders are dispatched within 24 hours on working days.
Delivery takes 2–5 working days depending on your city.
Free delivery on orders above Rs. 5,000; otherwise a flat Rs. 250 applies.
We currently do not deliver to Balochistan and Azad Kashmir.

returns.title: Refund & returns
body: Unused products in original packaging can be returned within 3 days of delivery.
Refunds are processed within 5–7 working days after the returned item passes inspection.
Warranty claims for manufacturing defects are handled per the brand’s warranty terms.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
body: Prices and availability are subject to change without notice.
Orders are confirmed only after verification by phone or WhatsApp.
By placing an order you agree to our delivery, returns and privacy policies.
